name: QCY Earbuds
author: bbztp
description: Control QCY earbuds (MeloBuds and other models) from the Omarchy bar: battery, active noise control, LDAC, multipoint, low-latency game mode, find-my-buds, and a readout of the earbuds' state.

barWidget.description: Battery in the bar; click for active noise control, multipoint/LDAC/game toggles, and a readout of the earbuds' state.

schema.label: Bluetooth scan time (seconds)
schema.description: How long to listen for the earbuds' low-energy advertisement before giving up. Longer is more reliable; an action or read waits at most this long.

schema.label: Device name match
schema.description: Case-insensitive substring used to recognise your earbuds among Bluetooth devices.
